packs.name: Bifrost code smells
packs.description: Curated structured RQLP checks for bug-prone and potentially expensive source patterns.

policies.severity_rationale: A proven constant condition outcome makes one conditional arm unreachable.
policies.remediation: Review the scalar assumptions and intended branch test before changing the code; no automatic rewrite is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: An exact JDK 21 String.trim() result is a pure transformed value and the caller discards it.
policies.remediation: Use or return the transformed value if intended; review why the call was made before removing it. No automatic fix is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: Dynamic evaluation converts data into executable code and expands both correctness and security risk.
policies.remediation: Replace dynamic evaluation with explicit dispatch, parsing, or a bounded data representation.

policies.severity_rationale: Two branch bodies have the same structured operations and proven reference identities, suggesting a copy/paste error or redundant condition.
policies.remediation: Review the intended behavior in each branch. Preserve condition evaluation, pattern binding and branch scope when changing code.

policies.severity_rationale: An exact JDK 21 Files.deleteIfExists(Path) call returns a status indicating whether a file was deleted; a direct expression statement discards it.
policies.remediation: Handle or deliberately ignore the status according to the caller's intent. I/O exceptions are separate; no automatic fix is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: A later ordered branch repeats an earlier test over stable ordinary bindings, so that later branch cannot be selected.
policies.remediation: Correct the repeated test or remove the unreachable branch after reviewing condition side effects and intended branch behavior.

policies.severity_rationale: Opposite Boolean-literal returns on immediate conditional paths are a verbose or mistaken outcome.
policies.remediation: Review the intended Boolean result and condition evaluation before changing the branch structure; no expression rewrite is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: General-purpose object deserializers can construct unexpected objects or execute attacker-controlled behavior.
policies.remediation: Use a data-only format, then validate the decoded schema before use.

policies.severity_rationale: A fully classified receiver includes a Proven class whose complete member surface lacks this access; unknown receivers and open member models are excluded.
policies.remediation: Pass a receiver with the required member, correct the member name, or guard the access using a condition the analyzer can prove. Inspect the class origin and retained witness before changing the caller.

policies.severity_rationale: Two exact conflicting accesses without ordering or compatible protection violate Go's data-race-free execution contract and can produce undefined program behavior.
policies.remediation: Order the accesses with a channel or completed task group, protect both accesses with the same compatible mutex, use an appropriate atomic operation consistently, or stop sharing the location.

policies.severity_rationale: Dereferencing a value that is nil on one or every reachable local path can panic, including a success-gated API result used before its reviewed condition is established.
policies.remediation: Prove the pointer non-nil before the operation, return from the nil path, or establish the API's reviewed success condition before using its result.

policies.severity_rationale: Returning an error-construction call that receives a different, provably nil error binding on an exact API failure path can hide the actual cause and may itself return nil.
policies.remediation: Pass the reviewed API's exact failure result to the returned error-construction call, or deliberately establish and use a separate non-nil error.

policies.severity_rationale: An empty catch body may silently discard failures when the catch is reached; this rule reports the structural body regardless of reachability.
policies.remediation: Review whether to handle or propagate the exception deliberately. No automatic fix is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: Writing an initialized scalar local back to the same binding is usually an accidental no-op and can hide a mistaken source or target.
policies.remediation: Remove the assignment or replace the right-hand side or target with the intended binding.

policies.severity_rationale: Writing an initialized ordinary local back to the same binding is usually an accidental no-op.
policies.remediation: Remove the assignment or use the intended source or target binding.

policies.severity_rationale: Adjacent crossed writes copy the first assigned value back into the second local, suggesting a failed swap.
policies.remediation: Review the intended operation; if a swap was intended, preserve the original value in a temporary or use the language's simultaneous assignment.

policies.severity_rationale: An exact ordinary local value is replaced on every modeled continuation before any read, so its original value is unused.
policies.remediation: Review the original assignment and its right-hand-side effects before changing it.

policies.severity_rationale: A reachable Java loop body cannot reach the same loop's repeat edge on any modeled continuation.
policies.remediation: Review the early exits and whether a loop is intended; no automatic rewrite is supplied.

policies.severity_rationale: All producer-authored entries to an exact Java statement are outside complete entry reachability.
policies.remediation: Review the preceding control flow and the intended statement before removing unreachable code.

policies.severity_rationale: The receiver's value is established outside the loop and no assignment inside re-establishes it, so the loop provably re-sorts one unchanged-identity value on every pass.
policies.remediation: Sort once before the loop or maintain order incrementally. Calls in deferred bodies are reported lexically; verify how often the body runs before restructuring.

policies.severity_rationale: Compiling the same regular expression repeatedly adds avoidable parser and automaton construction work.
policies.remediation: Compile loop-invariant expressions once and reuse the compiled pattern.

policies.severity_rationale: Synchronous or whole-file reads inside a loop can multiply I/O and allocation cost.
policies.remediation: Read once, stream or batch inputs, and cache loop-invariant content where semantics permit.

policies.severity_rationale: Repeated serialization can dominate loops through traversal, encoding, and allocation.
policies.remediation: Move loop-invariant serialization out of the loop or batch records into one encoder call.

policies.severity_rationale: Parsing the same representation per iteration repeats validation, tokenization, and object construction.
policies.remediation: Parse loop-invariant data once or use an incremental/batched parser for per-item input.

policies.severity_rationale: A database round trip per iteration is a common N+1 query pattern.
policies.remediation: Batch the operation, prefetch required rows, or use one set-oriented query.

policies.severity_rationale: A serial network request per iteration amplifies latency and remote-service load.
policies.remediation: Batch requests, prefetch data, or use explicitly bounded concurrency with backpressure.

policies.severity_rationale: Process creation is expensive and repeated launches can exhaust OS resources.
policies.remediation: Move invariant work outside the loop, use one long-lived process, or batch subprocess input.

policies.severity_rationale: Sleeping for every iterated item throttles the whole batch in lockstep.
policies.remediation: Prefer rate limiters or batching over per-item sleeps; keep deliberate poll and backoff sleeps in condition-controlled loops, which this rule does not flag.

policies.severity_rationale: I/O, parsing, serialization, sorting, or remote work under two loop levels can grow multiplicatively.
policies.remediation: Hoist invariant work, precompute indexes, batch external operations, or reduce the nested iteration space.

policies.severity_rationale: A blocking once-cell whose initializer joins on rayon can park the worker that owns the stolen re-entrant job and wedge the whole pool.
policies.remediation: Use a pool-safe memoization such as PoolSafeMemo::get_or_build_parallel, or build the value eagerly before entering the parallel region.

packs.name: Bifrost correctness
packs.description: Selectable lifecycle and ownership policies over reviewed acquisition families.

policies.severity_rationale: A resource that reaches a supported exit of its acquiring root while still open can leak a file descriptor, connection, or lock until process exit.
policies.remediation: Close the resource on every supported exit of the acquiring procedure, including the exceptional exit, or transfer ownership through a contract the analysis can prove.

packs.name: Bifrost security
packs.description: High-precision security policies backed by exact structural identity and value-flow evidence.

policies.severity_rationale: Attacker-controlled data used as JDBC SQL structure can change the executed statement and compromise application data.
policies.remediation: Use a PreparedStatement with placeholders and bind untrusted values through typed setter methods instead of concatenating SQL text.

policies.severity_rationale: Attacker-controlled command text can execute unintended operating-system commands with the application's privileges.
policies.remediation: Avoid passing untrusted text to Runtime.exec. Use a fixed executable and validate arguments against an allowlist.

policies.severity_rationale: A command string built from the process environment or the launch arguments runs in a subshell with the application's privileges, so attacker-controlled text changes the executed command.
policies.remediation: Do not pass process input to os.system. Use subprocess.run with an argument list and shell=False, and validate the executable against an allowlist.

policies.severity_rationale: A request value persisted through the declared store and read back into SQL text can change the executed statement and compromise application data.
policies.remediation: Pass untrusted values through the driver's parameter-binding contract instead of adding them to the SQL text.

policies.severity_rationale: A request value stored without the validator the workspace requires bypasses the application's own reviewed storage invariant.
policies.remediation: Pass request-derived values through the configured validator before storing them, or narrow the reviewed configuration if the obligation does not apply.

packs.name: Bifrost network-effect boundaries
packs.description: Configurable forbidden-network-effect specializations. Each policy asserts that one explicitly selected declaration reaches no declared network effect, directly or through workspace helpers. The effect is declared by a reviewed semantic model on the exact API identity; purity is never inferred from a name, a file name, a comment, or an unqualified annotation, and a repository that configures no selection carries no obligation.

policies.severity_rationale: A declaration the repository reviewed as a pure calculation reaching network I/O breaks the boundary the review relied on and can turn a local computation into an externally visible side effect.
policies.remediation: Move the effect to the caller, or make the selected declaration's helper chain reach no declared network effect. Configure the declaration-selection block with the exact declaration this repository protects before enabling the policy.
